title: squalify must measure its throughput on GB-scale wide files
lead: Adds a manual benchmark on generated GB-scale streams, including wide, right-padded fixed-width tables. It measures the three-pass design with five candidate tokenizers and records figures that inform any later decision to fuse passes. It changes no design by itself.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** merging passes or other optimisation (a separate item if the figures call for it); parallel processing; speed checks in CI.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Goal: a full streaming scan with bounded memory, at the sizes real files reach.

Sample-data review (2026-10-13), adopted by the owner: production-test exports reach several GB with hundreds of columns, and about 90% of their bytes are padding. Processing cost tracks cells rather than bytes, and the design reads the file three times. Nobody has measured squalify on such a file.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `tests/squalify.Tests/Sources/SyntheticCsvSource.cs` (from sq-11): adds a wide, padded mode: M columns of fixed width with right padding, a key preamble, annotation rows and a header, generated on the fly.
- `tests/squalify.Tests/Bench/ThroughputTests.cs`: `[Trait("Category","Large")]`, manual only. For a 1 GB stream, padded wide and plain, it records wall time, MB/s, cells/s and peak working set, for the byte pass alone and for the full profile, and asserts peak working set ≤ `MemoryBudget.CeilingBytes` (sq-11). `Bench_PaddedWide_4Gb` records the same figures for a 4 GB padded wide stream without asserting them; its figures go into the note only.
- A slicer note on this item with the figures, the machine class (no host names) and a recommendation: keep three passes, or file an item to fuse them.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `SyntheticCsvSource_PaddedWide_ConstantLineLength`: every table line has the same length, and the profiler reports `constantLineLength`.
2. `Bench_PaddedWide_1Gb` and `Bench_Plain_1Gb` (Large): complete with peak working set ≤ `MemoryBudget.CeilingBytes` (sq-11).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests.
2. Extend the source, then the benchmark.
3. Run the Large category by hand and record the note.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet format squalify.sln --verify-no-changes`
- If this slice changed architecture (the pipeline, an interface, a descriptor section or a determinism rule), `docs/how-it-works.md` and its diagrams are updated and `./scripts/render-docs.sh` has been re-run. The architect confirms there is no drift.
- `slicer check`
- One manual run of `dotnet test --filter Category=Large` (1 GB asserted, 4 GB recorded only), with the figures in a slicer note.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/sq-19` on branch `sq-19`. No agent commits. After the gate returns `VERDICT: PASS`, the orchestrator commits `sq-19: throughput benchmark` when the owner approves.
